lines.text: This sentence makes English teachers cry.
lines.tr: Questa frase fa piangere i professori d'inglese.

lines.text: Borrow means: take. Lend means: give.
lines.tr: Borrow vuol dire prendere in prestito. Lend vuol dire prestare.

lines.text: So say: can you lend me a pen?
lines.tr: Quindi di': can you lend me a pen?

lines.text: Or: can I borrow your pen?
lines.tr: Oppure: can I borrow your pen?

lines.text: Save this before you forget it.

bubbles.text: Can you borrow me a pen?
